query: UPDATE assistant_sessions SET state='cleaned',cleaned_at=now(),conversation_id=NULL WHERE id=$1 AND state<>'cleaned' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_uploads u WHERE u.workspace_id=assistant_sessions.workspace_id AND u.session_id=assistant_sessions.id AND u.state='reserved' AND u.created_at>now()-interval '60 seconds') AND (state='closed' OR expires_at<=now() OR last_seen_at<=now()-interval '15 minutes' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM access_tokens t WHERE t.id=login_id AND t.expires_at>now()))  AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_conversation_sources source WHERE source.workspace_id=assistant_sessions.workspace_id AND source.session_id=assistant_sessions.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_conversation_sources source WHERE source.workspace_id=assistant_sessions.workspace_id AND source.session_id=assistant_sessions.id AND (source.state='final' OR least(coalesce(assistant_sessions.closed_at,'infinity'::timestamptz),assistant_sessions.expires_at,assistant_sessions.last_seen_at+interval '15 minutes',coalesce((SELECT t.expires_at FROM access_tokens t WHERE t.id=assistant_sessions.login_id),now()))<=now()-interval '1 hour'))) RETURNING workspace_id
